spec: Nova designation normalisation and matching v1 (nova/docs/designation-matching.md; 05 §10, D20, E-2, E-19, T-1)
notice: TEST FIXTURES ONLY. Nothing here is production catalogue data or a verified technical fact. Relationships exist only where a fixture records them; see each catalogue's note.

sample-as-recorded.note: TEST FIXTURE derived from the Phase 2 prototype sample (design/phase2-v2-corrections/src/catalogue.json), with relationships exactly as that sample recorded them: 6200-6207 carry 2RS/ZZ variants; 6305-2RS and 22220 E were standalone rows, so they are standalone Products here (05 §9: unresolved relationship, no inferred claim). The sample's spellings (22220E, NU205, HK2520, UCP208) are omitted: each normalises to its own designation's key and would be a redundant duplicate key. No suffix rules are approved (V-1). NOT production catalogue data.

t1-recorded-relationship.note: HYPOTHETICAL TEST FIXTURE for the T-1 regression: models 6305-2RS and 22220 E as recorded variants of Products 6305 and 22220 with base_listed off, AS IF the Owner had verified those relationships (the 05 §25 example). It asserts no verified fact about these designations. NOT production catalogue data.

synthetic.note: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. The QZ designations, families and suffix tokens are invented to exercise the matching mechanism (spellings, unlisted variants, approved-token base series, ambiguity, precedence). They are not bearing designations and the tokens are not real suffix rules. NOT production catalogue data.
